style_notes.bridge: Keep the inherited 12-wide public road deck and its open clearance. Use pale molded rails and survey/end-abutment masonry before fitting a CP10 profile.
style_notes.tunnel: Use the CP03 mouth and CP13 rhythm of pale ribs and pinned white light. Their 16-wide envelope needs two reserved shoulder cells on each side of the 12-wide avenue. Grade changes keep their city profile.
style_notes.rock-cut: Keep boxed lining at exposed cuts and fit pale coping and planting pockets at the top lip.
style_notes.terrace: Keep the grade and six-block lane. Offset the outer pale curb, planters and river rail together at level bends.
